ratio_long_run.flow_units: C, Y and transfers: actual quarterly real flows multiplied by four to form annualized flow levels
ratio_long_run.stock_units: Real W80/W20 stocks are not annualized
ratio_long_run.transfer_mpc_status: Maintained assumption, not an estimated restriction tested here
ratio_long_run.training_isolation: Ratios, differences and all leads/lags constructed inside the stated training window; no holdout leads
ratio_long_run.inference: Unrestricted statsmodels OLS; Bartlett HAC n/(n-k) correction and pointwise t intervals
ratio_long_run.replication_status: Auxiliary adaptation motivated by Beach/Gamber/Moran; not the undisclosed Banque de France equation
ratio_long_run.identification: Conditional level relation; no causal identification or cointegration validation established by this fit
ratio_long_run.source_group_definition: Canonical W80/W20 income-group wealth; see input provenance

ratio_ecm.functional_form_status: Auxiliary Beach-compatible ratio/DOLS target, not an authors' Banque de France ECM equation
ratio_ecm.transfer_assumption: Long-run MPC out of transfers fixed at one by the referenced ratio normalization
ratio_ecm.wealth_coefficient_units: Annual consumption dollars per wealth-stock dollar; wealth is not annualized
ratio_ecm.target_error_definition: log observed quarterly C minus log positive ratio-predicted annual C/4
ratio_ecm.cointegration_test_status: No ordinary residual ADF/MacKinnon Engle-Granger test claimed for this nonlinear DOLS target
ratio_ecm.short_run_inference: Pointwise HAC conditional on fitted ratio/DOLS target; full two-stage bootstrap reported separately
ratio_ecm.identification: Conditional functional-form sensitivity, not causal wealth effects

bootstrap.method: Restore saved joint vectors, with both stages originally refitted
bootstrap.inference_status: Exploratory conditional percentile intervals; unresolved ECM diagnostics, fixed predictor paths and model form

log_ecm.functional_form_status: Declared log-form adaptation; Banque de France equations/normalization/lags not disclosed
log_ecm.short_run_inference: Bartlett HAC with n/(n-k) correction and t critical values; conditional on generated ECT
log_ecm.long_run_inference: Point estimates; full two-stage conditional residual bootstrap reported separately
log_ecm.identification: Conditional macro association; no causal instrument or imposed coefficient sign

engle_granger.method: statsmodels augmented Engle-Granger; MacKinnon cointegration critical values, not ordinary residual ADF p-values

log_ecm.cointegration_warning: No rejection of no cointegration; error-correction interpretation remains unvalidated
